name: tutor-setup
title_zh: 把任意知识源变成可提问的 Obsidian 学习库
tagline_zh: PDF、网页或代码仓库，自动识别模式并生成带练习题的笔记库。新成员看代码库不再从零摸索，直接拿到一份带路地图。
tagline_en: Drop in a PDF, webpage, or codebase—it auto-detects the mode and builds a study vault with practice questions.
desc_en: Transforms knowledge sources into an Obsidian StudyVault. Two modes: (1) Document Mode — PDF/text/web sources → study notes with practice questions. (2) Codebase Mode — source code project → onboarding vault for new developers. Mode is auto-detected based on project markers in CWD.
why_zh: 不是模板填充，而是按项目标记自动切换文档/代码两种模式，产物直接是 Obsidian 库结构。
why_en: No template stuffing—it switches between document and codebase modes via project markers, outputting a ready-to-use Obsidian.
limit_zh: 只认 CWD 里的项目标记（如 .git、package.json）来判定代码模式；纯图片 PDF 无法提取文字。
limit_en: Code mode only triggers on project markers in CWD (e.g., .git, package.json). Scanned-image PDFs yield no text. Questions are generative, not.
